author: nickyeow

english.text: I think of watching TV as a waste of time.
I think watching TV is a waste of time.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 tai2 din6 si6 hou2 saai1 si4 gaan3。
text: 我覺得睇電視好嘥時間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How kind of him to help us move on such a rainy day!

jyutping: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5，dou1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 bun1 uk1，keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jan4 aa1！
text: 落咁大雨，都幫我哋搬屋，佢真係好人呀！

author: Riko

english.text: It isn't expensive.

jyutping: ni1 go3 m4 gwai3。
text: 呢個唔貴。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I didn't have the heart to eat the cake she made me.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 se2 dak1 sik6 keoi5 zing2 bei2 ngo5 go2 gin6 daan6 gou1。
text: 我唔捨得食佢整俾我嗰件蛋糕。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can get an idea what we are doing here soon.

jyutping: nei5 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 ming4 ngo5 dei6 hai2 ni1 dou6 zou6 gan2 di1 me1 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你好快就會明我哋喺呢度做緊啲咩㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You will miss Japanese food in the United States.

jyutping: nei5 heoi3 dou3 mei5 gwok3 zau6 wui5 gwaa3 zyu6 jat6 bun2 di1 je5 sik6 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你去到美國就會掛住日本啲嘢食㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She kept on talking after I asked her to stop.

jyutping: ngo5 giu3 zo2 keoi5 ting4，keoi5 dou1 gai3 zuk6 gong2 je5。
text: 我叫咗佢停，佢都繼續講嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm sorry, I'm busy right now.

jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1，ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 mong4 aa3。
text: 唔好意思，我而家好忙呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She promised her mother to come home before nine without fail.

jyutping: keoi5 jing1 sing4 zo2 aa3 maa1 waa6 jat1 ding6 wui5 hai2 gau2 dim2 zi1 cin4 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2。
text: 佢應承咗阿媽話一定會喺九點之前返到屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: All of a sudden, the door shut with a bang.

jyutping: dou6 mun4 dat6 jin4 zi1 gaan1 paang1 jat1 seng1 saan1 maai4 zo2。
text: 道門突然之間砰一聲閂埋咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Staying at home is boring.

jyutping: lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 hou2 mun6。
text: 留喺屋企好悶。

author: fercheung

english.text: I bought a new sewing machine.

jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ji1 ce1。
text: 我買咗部新衣車。

author: kaenif

english.text: He lives near my house.

jyutping: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6。
text: 佢住喺我屋企附近。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They fell asleep after the movie.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 tai2 jyun4 tou3 hei3 zi1 hau6 zau6 fan3 zoek6 zo2。
text: 佢哋睇完套戲之後就瞓著咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will you have a Christmas party at your home?

jyutping: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 gaau2 sing3 daan3 party aa3？
text: 你會唔會喺屋企搞聖誕party呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: What's your favorite Christmas carol?

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 sau2 sing3 daan3 go1 aa3？
text: 你最鍾意邊首聖誕歌呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tampering with evidence is a serious offense.

jyutping: cyun3 goi2 zing3 geoi3 hai6 jim4 zung6 zeoi6 hang6。
text: 竄改證據係嚴重罪行。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why do you hate Tom so much?

jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 gam3 zang1 aa3 Tom zik1？
text: 你做咩咁憎阿Tom唧？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sami is late again.

jyutping: sam1 mei5 jau6 ci4 dou3 laa3。
text: 森美又遲到喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sami muttered something that I couldn't hear.

jyutping: sam1 mei5 ngam4 ngam4 cam4 cam4 ngaam1 gong2 zo2 di1 je5，daan6 hai6 ngo5 teng1 m4 dou3 keoi5 gong2 me1。
text: 森美吟吟沉沉啱講咗啲嘢，但係我聽唔到佢講咩。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm ignorant, but at least I recognize the limits of my knowledge.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 mou4 zi1，daan6 hai6 zi3 siu2 ngo5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 sik1 ge3 je5 m4 do1。
text: 我好無知，但係至少我知道自己識嘅嘢唔多。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He always puts himself first.

jyutping: keoi5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 baai2 hai2 dai6 jat1 wai6。
text: 佢永遠都將自己擺喺第一位。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I just found an old diary.

jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 wan2 dou3 bun2 gau6 jat6 gei3。
text: 我啱啱搵到本舊日記。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: They do not speak English or French.
She does not speak English or French.
He does not speak English or French.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 sik1 gong2 jing1 man4 ding6 hai6 faat3 gwok3 man4。
text: 佢唔識講英文定係法國文。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Stop changing your mind! A while ago, you said you wanted to go, but now you say you don't want to. Are you really going or aren't you?

jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceot1 ji5 faan2 ji5 maa3！tau4 sin1 waa6 jiu3 heoi3，ji4 gaa1 waa6 m4 jiu3 laa3，nei5 dou3 dai2 heoi3 m4 heoi3 aa3？
text: 你唔好咁出爾反爾嘛！頭先話要去，而家話唔要喇，你到底去唔去呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Every cat has its own personality.

jyutping: mui5 zek3 maau1 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing3 gaak3。
text: 每隻貓都有自己嘅性格。

author: corina

english.text: Tom left after one week.

jyutping: tong1 mou5 jat1 zau1 hau6 lei4 hoi1。
text: 湯姆一週後離開。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: You don't need to tell me. I don't have any interest in this matter.

jyutping: m4 sai2 gong2 laak3，ngo5 deoi3 ni1 di1 si6 jat1 di1 hing3 ceoi3 dou1 mou4。
text: 唔使講嘞，我對呢啲事一啲興趣都無。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom won't buy that.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 m4 wui5 maai5 go2 go3 lo1！
text: 阿湯唔會買嗰個囉！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom became rich overnight.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 jat1 je6 gaan1 bin3 zo2 go3 jau5 cin2 jan4。
text: 阿湯一夜間變咗個有錢人。

author: FishlandicFishy

english.text: Now, they know we are here.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1，keoi5 dei6 zi1 dou6 ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6。
text: 而家，佢哋知道我哋喺度。

english.text: These stories are as old as anything that men have invented. They were narrated by naked savage women to naked savage children. They have been inherited by our earliest civilised ancestors, who really believed that beasts and trees and stones can talk if they choose, and behave kindly or unkindly. The stories are full of the oldest ideas of ages when science did not exist, and magic took the place of science.

jyutping: ni1 di1 gu3 si6 tung4 naam4 jan2 faat3 ming4 ge3 jam6 ho4 je5 jat1 joeng6 gam3 gu2 lou5，keoi5 dei6 hai6 jau4 lo2 tai2 ge3 je5 maan4 neoi5 jan2 hoeng3 lo2 tai2 ge3 je5 maan4 siu2 pang4 jau5 gong2 ge3 hang4 wai4 sin6 loeng4 waak6 ze2 m4 sin6 loeng4，gu3 si6 cung1 mun5 zo2 fo1 hok6 mei6 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 nin4 doi6 zeoi3 gu2 lou5 ge3 soeng2 faat3，mo1 faat3 ceoi2 doi6 zo2 fo1 hok6。
text: 呢啲故事同男人發明嘅任何嘢一樣咁古老，佢哋係由裸體嘅野蠻女人向裸體嘅野蠻小朋友講嘅 行為善良或者唔善良，故事充滿咗科學未存在嘅年代最古老嘅想法，魔法取代咗科學。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the sunny afternoon of the 24th of February of 2022, on my way to the cafe, I saw bearded Brian in front of the pub, as he talked about poutine with bacon served inside the establishment. At the cafe, I drank my usual iced black tea. There were handsome men in green and black, or in grey, or in black. There were many students. A couple of girls carried multicoloured flowers. Hans the Netherlander astronomy buff talked about the ongoing politics with Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Coincidentally, a family of Russian-speaking Eurasians just from the barbershop, owned by a Middle Easterner, passed through the cafe. The cafe ambiance was not exactly like in Ten Forward, the crew lounge in the Star Trek franchise.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 2 jyut6 24 hou6 cing4 long5 ge3 haa6 zau3，ngo5 heoi3 gaa3 fe1 gun2 ge3 lou6 soeng6，ngo5 gin3 dou2 jau5 wu4 sou1 ge3 Brian hai2 zau2 baa1 cin4 min6，keoi5 gong2 gan2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jap6 min6 gung1 jing3 ge3 poutine pui3 maai4 jin1 juk6。hai2 cafe dou6，ngo5 jam2 zo2 ngo5 ping4 si4 jam2 hoi1 ge3 dung3 hak1 caa4。go2 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 hok6 saang1。ho4 laan1 tin1 man4 oi3 hou3 ze2 hon3 si1 gong2 dou3 ngo4 lo4 si1 jap6 cam1 wu1 hak1 laan4 ge3 ci4 zuk6 zing3 zi6。haau2 hap6 gam2, jat1 gaa1 ngaam1 ngaam1 lai4 zi6 lei5 faat3 dim3 ge3 ngo4 jyu5 au1 aa3 jan4，jau4 jat1 go3 zung1 dung1 jan4 jung2 jau5，ging1 gwo3 ni1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 gun2。gaa3 fe1 teng1 ge3 hei3 fan1 m4 ci5《sing1 zai3 mai4 hong4》hai6 lit6 ge3 kek6 zou2 jau1 sik1 sat1「sap6 cin4 zeon3」。
text: 喺2022年2月24號晴朗嘅下晝，我去咖啡館嘅路上，我見到有鬍鬚嘅 Brian 喺酒吧前面，佢講緊間餐廳入面供應嘅 poutine 配埋煙肉。喺cafe度，我飲咗我平時飲開嘅凍黑茶。嗰度有好多學生。荷蘭天文愛好者漢斯講到俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭嘅持續政治。巧合噉, 一家啱啱嚟自理髮店嘅俄語歐亞人，由一個中東人擁有，經過呢間咖啡館。咖啡廳嘅氣氛唔似《星際迷航》系列嘅劇組休息室「十前進」。
